reviews.text: Dr. Washatka is great; he is thorough and he really cares about his patients. I feel safe trusting my best friend with him
They were great with Oliver
I came in with my dog after she ran over something that cut her and they got her in very quickly and took great care of her and I’m very thankful
First time taking my dog to City Vet ,I tell you Dr.Wallace is awesome I recommend this place to any pet Owner..I will be back Great customer service from the staffs
Dr Ellen Tunnel is awesome .The staff are great too and very friendly.
Thank you, Miguel, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your feedback!

I am a big fan of Cityvet White Rock and have complete faith in them having my four dog’s well being as their top priority. I am involved in dog rescue and often asked about vet recommendations and Dr Farr and Team are it, without hesitation!
Thank you, Eve, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!
Great vets...  they always listen and address concerns

Dr. Deangeles was very attentive to Chili Dawg in an effort to determine what is causing his bumps and cyst like areas. She and her assistant made him feel calm and safe while making the examination.  They really care about their furry clients and their families.

I went to urgent care when other vets were closed. Spent almost $400 and no change in pet condition. 2 days later, went to my local vet who correctly treated the pet and complete turnaround, no more throwing up. It cost another 400 but it was a relief when her condition improved
Had another excellent experience at City Vet today. They are all so kind and caring. I saw Dr. Chaffin.
Best vet around with reasonable prices!!
Always feel welcomed and well taken care of. My dog Churro has been coming here for years.

We have been going to CityVet for over 10 years for our animals. Before we found them, we always had a hard time finding thorough, caring and honest vets. We are beyond grateful we crossed paths with CityVet White Rock. All the doctors are amazing and truly care for animals. We recently had to put our 15 year old German shepherd to sleep and Dr. Wallace ,plus all other employees, were so compassionate and understanding. They took their time with us, helped to reassure we were doing the right thing and Liz even sent a beautiful card signed by all staff with our pup’s paw print. So grateful we have that.  The manager, Abby, was very responsive and sweet when helping us set up the appointment. I’ve never experienced a vet office with this much efficient communication and such high level of care! Thank you for all the years of taking care of our pets!!

We are incredibly grateful to Dr. DeAngelis for the compassionate and dedicated care she has given our beloved dog, Mika. From the very beginning, she has treated Mika with kindness, patience, and genuine concern, while also taking the time to listen to us and explain everything clearly.
It is comforting to know that Mika is in the hands of a veterinarian who truly cares—not only about the medical treatment, but about the well-being and quality of life of the animal and the peace of mind of the family.
Dr. DeAngelis has been wonderful throughout Mika’s care, and we sincerely appreciate her professionalism, compassion, and commitment. We highly recommend her to anyone looking for a veterinarian who treats their pets as more than just patients, but as beloved members of the family.
Thank you, Dr. DeAngelis, for caring for Mika with so much love and compassion! ❤️🐾
Dr. Chaffin was GREAT with my dog!!! The entire staff is Super!!! Wouldn't think of going anywhere else!

I don't understand the good reviews, super super billing focused. Many of their customers probably have the money for it and don't notice or care. But they will try to up charge you, add services you don't need and try to convince you that you should get them (beyond routine services).

Check your receipt, they will change your appointment to an urgent appointment even if routine to increase their billing. Try to use scare tactics to get you to get additional vaccinations even if they don't make sense for your pet. They will also try to make as many excuses to get you to come in to charge the $90 appointment fee, and then charge an extra 30% for urgent. Pretty scammy overall, wouldn't recommend them to anyone who values their dollar.

If you have a lot of money and you go here for convenience fine, but check the bill and do your own research. I'm sure you didn't get your money by throwing it away.
very kind doctors and staff.
Wonderful visit. Very positive.  Dr Tunnel took the time to explain everything and answer all my questions and concerns!
Very  fast and professional service
Thank you, Sk, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!
It is the only that Dalllas I like to use. The staff is so friendly and I feel like they truly care about your pet.
Thank you for your 5-star review!
I like the fact they were very thorough with me in her care. They were friendly and professional.
Overpriced.
They’re always very nice to my pups.  They seem to really like their jobs.
Love them.

I’ve been bringing my pets to CityVet White Rock for years, and while I’ve shared my appreciation before, this week’s experience reminded me why I keep coming back. My two puppies recently had dental cleanings, and even though it’s a routine procedure, I was still nervous. Handing over your pets and waiting while they’re under anesthesia is never easy. Dr. Farr and her team were incredible from start to finish. The communication, updates, and genuine care they showed made a stressful day feel so much easier.

What stood out most was how personal the experience felt. I never felt like just another client or that my puppies were just another appointment. It was clear that Dr. Farr and her team truly cared about them and understood how much they mean to me. When I picked them up, I knew they had been well cared for, and the thoughtful follow-up afterward only reinforced that feeling. Great veterinary care is important, but finding a team that treats your pets like family is something special. I am incredibly grateful for Dr. Farr and everyone at CityVet White Rock for taking such wonderful care of my babies.

This is where you go when another [highly-rated] practice did not take the time.

Dr Angelis is wonderful and we will give my Penny the best quality of care, keeping her comfortable.

Thank you everyone for your time and care!
~~~
Penny has now crossed the Rainbow Bridge~ how it is planned: extraordinary.
Pricey ,but, there when we needed it most. We are very satisfied with the outcome of our fur baby needs. Thank  you for going above and beyond to help with yhe financing
Wonderful staff. Love Dr Farr she is the greatest.
Great vet!

Ms. Beth and Dr. Meladee were so amazing, helpful, and extremely kind. Their humanity and empathy for little fellows goes beyond words. Thank you so much for helping us take care of the stray we found not doing too well! He is perking up and we have high hopes he’ll make it through. May God bless y'all infinitely!

brought my cat to Dr. DeAngelis, and she was very kind and informative and so helpful! i appreciate the transparency on prices here and the ability to get estimates. i will be coming here again for future visits!
Love this vet! Dr. Diangelis is our favorite but every vet and tech in the team is caring and treats our dog like their own. Highly recommend!

Losing a pet is so difficult, but deciding when is the right time, when their suffering is too great, when your need, you love, for them is out weighed by their right to painless peace, is a terrible decision.  My little guy deserved better.  I turned to Midway Hollow for help. They treated me and my precious Boston Terrier with such kindness and respect!  I will be forever grateful for the loving treatment we received. I could not have asked for more. His chin resting on little crossing paws, he felt safe and loved. I would recommend the entire staff for their professionalism.

This is a very well run clinic. The front desk and tech employees are friendly and knowledgeable. Dr. Washatka is absolutely wonderful! He’s not only incredibly knowledgeable, but also kind and compassionate. He has taken exceptional care of my dogs—and of me as well. I feel so fortunate to have such a dedicated and trustworthy veterinarian caring for my pets.
Thank you for your 5-star review!
Thank you for taking the time to leave a review, Chaz. We appreciate your feedback and support!
Love these people. Dr Washatka really came through when Otis developed IVDD and a year later he’s managing life and all the techs are kind and considerate. Sue Ellen especially. Recommended!

CityVet White Rock is an excellent facility for your pets! We took Whittle there today and our experience was excellent! The entire staff is outstanding! Dr DeAngelis and Nurse Jo took great care of us today – they are so nice, professional, knowledgeable - Whittle and I both loved how well we were treated! I would recommend CityVet White rock to anyone and everyone!
Thank you, Jeff, for taking the time to leave a review. We appreciate your support!

Dr. Farr is hands down the best vet. She is so attentive and caring. I can’t imagine not having her by my side through my pets multiple surgeries and now as they age. I cannot recommend her enough. The staff is also incredibly friendly!
Bringing a credit card machine to collect payment while we’re discussing having to put our dog down is an odd choice

CityVet has taken care of our fur babies (two dogs and one cat) for about 4 years now. We’ve had boarding services, dental cleanings, and exams from at least three vets and have never had a bad experience. They are all very knowledgeable and genuinely try to do what’s best for the pet.

The facility is always clean and the service is always friendly and usually fairly quick.

We had frequent weekly visits with Dr. DeAngelis and staff for our aging cat and they truly cared for him like family. We unfortunately had to make the tough decision to say goodbye to him and they gave us the time and empathy to savor those last moments with him. They talked us through all the steps and it never felt like a rushed process. DeAngelis also went above and beyond and came in on her day off to facilitate the process.

We are forever grateful to have a vet in the neighborhood that we can trust to guide us through those tough decisions and treat our most cherished family members as their own. 🧡
They care about your pets and take great care of them.

Could not recommend City Vet White Rock any more highly.  They took such amazing care of both of our dogs Etta and Penelope and we will be forever grateful of how thoroughly they took care of our fur babies whether it was from catching a mast cell tumor that another vet clinic missed, dental surgery for a fractured tooth,  GI issues, and being on top of the ball with anything and everything else our dogs needed!  If you want a vet where your pet can walk in and the staff instantly make you feel like family instead of a patient, definitely check out City Vet White Rock!
- Bilal Ahmad, MD
Dr. Tunnell is the best.  She takes her time and a personal interest in not only my fur babies but in me.  Highly recommend.
Thank you, Lois, for the fantastic 5-star rating; we truly appreciate your support!

Been going to this vet for the past 6 years and I don’t have a single complaint! I don’t know how they do it, but everyone acts like they want to be there and truly care for my dog. Very thankful for them.
The folks at City Vet have the best interest and care for animals.  I know cause they are great with my fur babies.   It is not just the Vets it is everyone who wirks there.  Wonderful medical care.

I have trusted Dr. Washatka with my animals for years, and he remains the standard I compare every other vet to.

Since he moved across town, I haven’t found the same level of care near me. I haven’t made it to his new clinic yet, but I am absolutely finding a way to get there because he’s worth the drive.

Dr. Wasaka isn’t just knowledgeable — he practices medicine with common sense, experience, and respect. He doesn’t order unnecessary tests, and he treats pet parents as partners, listening closely to what we’ve observed and what’s worked for our animals in the past. His instincts are excellent, and he balances textbook knowledge with real-world judgment — a rare combination these days.

My daughter, my best friend, and my parents all rely on him too. When multiple generations and households trust the same veterinarian, that says everything about his care.

If you want a vet who is thoughtful, experienced, practical, and truly invested in your pet’s well-being, Dr. Wasaka is worth going out of your way for!!!

Dr. David Washatka is very unprofessional and shouldn’t be handling any pets.
My dog went into his office last Friday and David released him and said all his symptoms were normal. We took him home thinking he was fine until our dog was breathing really irrationally and we sent him a video and he still said it was NORMAL.
We obviously didn’t take his word for it and decided to go to ANOTHER EMERGENCY ROOM where they rushed our dog to the back and had him hospitalized for 24 hours because he was experiencing an intense infection that was running in his blood stream already.
Thankfully we acted quickly and the amazing doctors were able to save his life.
If you want your pet to be treated with the care and attention that every pet deserves, I wouldn’t have David as your doctor.
Thank you, Ali, for taking the time to leave a review. Your support means a lot to us!
Thank you, Annalise, for taking the time to leave a review! We appreciate your support!

These guys do really the best job I have been around in Dallas for the past 20+ years. They make correct diagnosis’s and are reasonably priced. Just picked up one pet from surgery and they did a great job!
Thank you for your review! :)
Thank you for your 5-star review!

Highly recommended! It was the first time I took my Chihuahua there, and everyone treated her very well, even though my dog ​​is quite mischievous. The doctor was lovely, and their prices are very reasonable. This will definitely be my dog's clinic from now on.
Great experience and timely service

My dogs have been going to City Vet for 6 years (Oak Lawn then moved and currently at this Lakewood location). The vets, techs amd everyone there are always so kind and loving. Something horrible happened to my senior dog and due to my availability and it being a Saturday I had to find another vet. It was a HORRIBLE experience. Cityvet was able to get him in Monday immediately. Dr. Farr is AMAZING. She was so calm, knowledgeable and had all the answers. I had hope again that he will be ok!!! She Even sent me a link to a liver supplement to be proactive as he's a senior dog. She called me less than 24hours later to discuss his blood work and stool test (everything was awesome). There was some elevated marker but she was so calm and said it was nothing to worry about (once again, her calm demeanor and knowledge kept me calm and gave us hope). The other vet tried to sell me $1500worth of tests BEFORE the vet even saw him. CityVet never tries to do any of that orbuse any sales tactics-in fact, they always find the most cost effective option if blood work needs to be done. And long story short, putting him down or letting him live his final moments was the other vet's recommendations. Thank God for Dr. Farr-my senior dog is back to normal and healthy. It made me realize just how amazing CityVet is and it's nice to be able to go to any location and they will have your dogs paperwork and history in their system!

I can’t say enough good things about CityVet White Rock and Dr. Chaffin! She is absolutely amazing with my dog; she literally gets down on the floor to just love on her for the first few minutes of every visit. It’s so heartwarming to see a vet who truly loves what she does.

Dr. Chaffin is not only incredibly kind but also so knowledgeable and thorough. I always leave feeling confident that my dog is getting the very best care. Recently, the office and Dr. Chaffin even went out of their way to help me navigate my insurance, which ended up saving me over $200!

The whole team truly goes above and beyond. I’m so grateful to have found such a caring and dedicated vet clinic. Highly recommend! 🐾
The staff is amazing and caring. They treated my kitty wonderfully! From start to finish, my first experience with this vet was a pleasure!
Thank you, Sue, for the fantastic 5-star rating; we truly appreciate your support!
Wonderful office. The Drs and staff are amazing and take great care of all of our babies.

Very disappointing
No words
Thank you for your positive feedback!
Very friendly staff & excellent vets.
Doc was overcommunicative on what she was doing and why. I appreciated it greatly. Felt like I got great service and I am pleased with the end result

They saved the day for us. We were able to get a last minute appointment after a hiccup with another location. Everyone was so patient and kind to us and our pups. We are now HUGE fans of Dr. Tunnell and the White Rock location.
Thank you for your 5-star review!
City Vet at White Rock was amazing today. They got us in last minute and provided excellent care. We will definitely be back!!

We love Dr. Farr and all the staff at City Vet -White Rock Lake & Urgent Care. They always take great care of our babies expecially today when Bentley was biten by a snake. They got him in and took exceptional care of him. I would recommend them to everyone!

The staff at City Vet here have done a fantastic job of taking care of our pets and addressing any of our concerns. From checkups to procedures, we always leave informed and well taken care of. I highly suggest making this location your animal’s medical care provider.

Everyone was very kind and caring. We have an old pup and just needed simple, clear advice moving forward. It is the first time in years I’ve been to a vet and I didn’t feel like they were trying to add extra tests, medicines, purchases that weren’t really necessary. Really liked our vet and nurse and will be returning when needed to CityVet!
Dr. Farr and her entire team take an excellent care of my dogs! They truly care about the health and wellbeing of your pets.

We are so very grateful for the kind, genuine, and compassionate team at White Rock City Vet. Their knowledge and experience is evident during every appointment. Our dogs have complex medical histories, so it means so much to us that their team always makes us feel heard and taken care of.

Getting our pup in was quick and easy, as always. Dr. Sidwa was very kind, compassionate, caring but even moreso, very thorough listening and evaluating our every concern. The care and treatment she provided helped a very stressful event turn out peaceful.
i would give 0 stars i needed to get my tiny pomerian dog her vaccines but they sent me out because supposedly she was too aggressive and they was scared “a tiny pomerian dog”

Thank you for your feedback, Andrew. I appreciate your input and understand there may be areas for improvement, please feel free to reach out at 214-239-2348 if you'd like to discuss your experience further. -Abby, Practice Manager.
I'm very happy with the service provided.     Very caring and professional.  My Pilón was comfortable and at ease with them handling him, which is unusual for him. Thank you much!

This vet was a lifesaver, quite literally. I found a stray kitten last night and they were able to get me in for an appointment next day. The staff was so welcoming and friendly, and Dr. DeAngelis was a an angel. I cannot thank her enough for being so kind and empathetic. Thanks to them I am going to be able to afford to save this kitten’s life and give it a forever home.

I’d also like to point out that the vet appointment fee is quite lower than some of the other vets in the area. I called around to several places and it was half the price of other clinics nearby.

I look forward to bringing my kitten back and my other adult fur baby for all vet services in the near future.

Ariana, we’re sorry to hear that your experience didn’t meet your expectations. Your feedback is important to us, and we would love the opportunity to learn more about your concerns. I am unable to locate you in our system, so if you could please give me a call at 214-239-2348 to discuss your experience I would appreciate it. - Abby, Practice Manager

From initial contact (which we were able to text), to walking out the door, this was an amazing vet experience.  Dr. Tunnell was so sweet with our senior fur baby and gave us straight forward but empathetic advice.  I would absolutely recommend City Vet White Rock to everyone.

After vomitting blood, we took our dog Rex in to see Dr. DeAngelis. Unfortunately, Rex was diagnosed with a terminal illness: a large tumor mass in his abdomen that had metastasized into countless nodules in his lungs. Due to his refusal to eat, difficulty breathing, and general pain, our family made the difficult decision to ease Rex's pain and put him to sleep. Dr. DeAngelis and her team were wonderful throughout this emotionally devastating time by ensuring Rex was comfortable. They gave him fluids, steroids, and anti-nausea medicine so we could take him home and spend some more time together before saying goodbye. When it came time to say goodbye, a quiet and comfortable area made to look like a living room was used.  The staff provided treats and water to Rex and gave me enough time alone with him before and after the process.  We can't thank them enough for providing such a soothing and respectful experience on what might the worst day of a person's life. The staff later sent a sympathy card that included Rex's pawprint. Thanks to Dr. DeAngelis and her team for allowing Rex to leave this world pain free and in a dignified manner.

RIP Rex, we love you!
Thank you, Lem, for the 5-star rating! Your support means a lot to us.

The kindness they show my babies makes all the difference. I love all the vets and the techs and the front desk staff are kind and patient and professional. 10/10 would recommend this vet for any pet parents

I was recently here and unfortunately had to put my kitty to sleep. I wanted to thank Tony, Nick and Dr. Chaffin who were all so compassionate and handled everything with so much care. Even when we had to speak about payment, Nick handled it in a very delicate and compassionate way. I know it has to be difficult to talk money in situations like that, but he did so gracefully. Thank you for being an amazing team and for caring so much for our pets, and us. I felt the love and it really made this sad time less traumatizing.

First time to this clinic but have a longer relationship with Dr. Washatka. The staff was very helpful, professional, and friendly,  The facility was well maintained. Dr. Washatka is my favorite vet of all times and has been compassionate, upbeat, and helpful with both of my pets. Highly recommend
We use them for our boarding and vet care - very compassionate and caring. Highly recommend.
Staff are patient, professional and sensitive to pet needs. Excellent option for your fur babies!
Thank you, Dave, for the fantastic 5-star rating; we truly appreciate your support!

They are AMAZING! We took our little Boston when she suddenly started limping. I cannot say enough about the kindness and care that Dr.Farr and her staff provided to us. They explained the situation, did some diagnostic x-rays and helped us understand what the issue was. They prescribed and filled the needed meds, gave her a full exam, made a follow-up appointment as well as ordering her records from our former vet and put in standing orders for her regular allergy shots. We just moved to the neighborhood from Richardson and have found our new vet! Highly recommend this veterinarian and facility. And the prices for an urgent care visit were very reasonable and much less than other places we have been. I am so grateful that we found Dr.Farr, her great staff  and this City Vet !

So I booked an appointment for my little kittens that were just born cause 2 of them didn’t look so good. I had already started alternative methods a couple days before due to appts being booked. They told me that it would be 75 to see all of them, staff is all lovely and wonderful. Now when the exam was going it was all info I was already aware of and dues the kittens being 2 weeks old nothing really could be done for them…. I even weighed them myself to see good thing I did cause they weren’t. And than they tell me that I can only really wait it out and maybe add a formula for the weaker 2. So then the get the ready to charge and they are like you got a discount and I’m like yesss that’s great!  It’s only gonna be 150…. Now when they called me back they had already told me it was only going to be for 75 and they left a voicemail so I had the proof. They agreed on the 75 but than I asked what about the discount? Turns out it’s 75 for each of these kittens! Can u imagine if they did nothing at all for you except tell you what you already knew…… I went ahead and paid the 75 cause they did get seen and the vet spent time looking at them. The problem I have is the communication issues. So yall be careful and always ask question before just paying!
they take such good care of my pets and are reasonably priced compared to many other vets that just arent nearly as good! great service for my fur babies
First visit today staff are friendly and knowledgeable! Definitely will bring my pup back here!

We have been taking our dogs to CityVet for several years. Even after we moved away from the area of this office in Dallas. I am impressed with communications, the assistance of the front desk staff, the compassion of the vet techs And be helpfulness in general. I have seen many vets, however, they are all thorough and caring. Kudos to the front desk, staff, in particular!

We love Dr. Sidwa and CityVet White Rock! They've taken such great care of my sweet Gnocchi boy. Dr.Sidwa treated Gnocchi after he fractured his leg, changing out his wrapping weekly. She also gave him the rest of his vaccines and recently performed his neuter surgery. I know he's in good hands with her and the team. Gnocchi loves all the attention he gets there and I love knowing he is well taken care of there. Thank you for taking great care of my furbaby!
